entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane under Phyrexian invasion, whose inhabitants fight the spreading corruption.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders corrupting Mirrodin with oil, seeking to make all worlds bow to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native inhabitants of Mirrodin who resist the Phyrexian infection.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin beneath the white sun, home of the leonin.

entities.name: Battle of Liet Field
entities.description: A battle after which the white sun crested above Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Axsh
entities.description: A lesser cenobite who speaks of the unworthy.

entities.name: Qal-Sha
entities.description: A Priest of Norn.

entities.name: Juryan
entities.description: A rebel leader who tells his followers the Phyrexians are vulnerable.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Grand Cenobite of the Phyrexians who speaks of their glorious infection.

entities.name: Pelyus
entities.description: A vedalken ordinar who speaks of the Origin Query.

entities.name: Origin Query
entities.description: A vedalken inquiry that must wait while they survive.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian Core Augur whose hands bless the Consecrated Sphinx.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A creator whose body is corroded by Phyrexian contagion and whose creation is now his master.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: A Neurok agent.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A speaker who scorns Phyrexian understanding of nature.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A Neurok agent.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A speaker who calls Phyrexians tenacious rather than clever.

entities.name: Rhmir
entities.description: A Phyrexian Hand of the Augur.

entities.name: Varil
entities.description: A Neurok partisan.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Phyrexian Lord of the Vault with corpse-dredgers.

entities.name: Isila
entities.description: A Priest of Sheoldred.

entities.name: Gyed
entities.description: A Vault Priest.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor called the Whispering One, who speaks of compleating and of many worlds bowing to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gerkk
entities.description: A character whose healing knowledge was limited.

entities.name: Qerk
entities.description: A goblin warrior of the Secret Warren.

entities.name: Kethek
entities.description: A furnace stoker.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Urabrask the Hidden, who speaks of reforging in fires of glory.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Koth of the Hammer, a leader of Mirran resistance who sent partisans to bring survivors to the tunnels below Kuldotha.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A place with tunnels below it that serve as a safe haven.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: A wild region of Mirrodin, home to Vorinclex and the mantises.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Phyrexian called Voice of Hunger who rules the Tangle by predation.

entities.name: Tilien
entities.description: A Sylvok partisan.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A hunter who speaks of predation.

entities.name: Oxid Ridge
entities.description: A place from which survivors are on the move and where a strike is planned.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A leader whose warriors are the last defense against the coming storm.

entities.name: Thrun, the Last Troll
entities.description: A troll punished for the crime of silence.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: A renegade leader.

entities.name: Tae Aquil
entities.description: A Viridian weaponsmith.

entities.name: Sadra Alic
entities.description: A Neurok strategist.

entities.name: Kessla
entities.description: A Sylvok shaman.

entities.name: Ketuc
entities.description: Ketuc of the Helm, planning a strike at Oxid Ridge.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Designed myr to follow the levelers and reaffix lost parts.

events.summary: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crests above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to the survivors.
events.quote: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

events.summary: Koth sends partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the tunnels below Kuldotha.
events.quote: Koth sent partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the safe haven of the tunnels below Kuldotha.

events.summary: As Phyrexian contagion corrodes Karn's body, the praetors whisper psalms to corrupt his mind.
events.quote: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

events.summary: Mirran partisans create hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.
events.quote: The Mirran partisans created hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.

events.summary: Ketuc prepares a spin engine for the strike at Oxid Ridge.
events.quote: It will be battle-ready before our strike at Oxid Ridge, and it will guarantee our victory.

relations.quote: "May our blessings sever the tongues of the forsaken." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
